experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form an $f0 dependency chain.

latencies.notes: Latency depends on the operand. The cases were measured with a reset chain calibrated against fadd; see the analysis page for the model.

cases.notes: helper reset chain, its cost calibrated against fadd.s (5.99 cycles)

experiment.name: exact result, subnormal operand
experiment.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 800 --unroll2 1600 --iters 40 --warmup 10 --reps 3 --init 'li.d $r4, 2097152; movgr2fr.w $f0, $r4; li.d $r8, 2097152' --asm 'fsqrt.s $f0, $f0; movfr2gr.s $r6, $f0; and $r6, $r6, $r0; or $r6, $r6, $r8; movgr2fr.w $f0, $r6'

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fsqrt.s $f0, $f8; fsqrt.s $f1, $f9; fsqrt.s $f2, $f10; fsqrt.s $f3, $f11; fsqrt.s $f4, $f12; fsqrt.s $f5, $f13; fsqrt.s $f6, $f14; fsqrt.s $f7, $f15
throughput.init: li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f8, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f9, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f10, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f11, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f12, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f13, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f14, $r4; li.w $r4, 0x3f800000; movgr2fr.w $f15, $r4' --asm 'fsqrt.s $f0, $f8; fsqrt.s $f1, $f9; fsqrt.s $f2, $f10; fsqrt.s $f3, $f11; fsqrt.s $f4, $f12; fsqrt.s $f5, $f13; fsqrt.s $f6, $f14; fsqrt.s $f7, $f15'
throughput.notes: Data-dependent. 8 independent lanes. CPI ~1.5 for special values, ~2.0 for exact squares, ~5.0 for general inputs, up to ~5.25 with maxsub/minsub. CPI is unchanged for 1-20 independent lanes; mixed fast/slow lanes are additive.

notes: Latency and throughput are data-dependent. The latency range was re-measured with unroll=100000; unroll=1000 produced values about 0.2 cycles lower because the per-call overhead was not fully amortised. Throughput is initiation-interval bound: CPI is unchanged from 1 to 20 independent lanes, and mixed fast/slow lanes are additive.
